test_title: PYST 5: SSC Stenographer - Reasoning (Held On:13 Oct, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Three statements are given followed by four conclusions numbered I, II, III and IV. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All laptops are desktops.

All desktops are printers.

Some printers are monitors.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some laptops are monitors.

II. Some monitors are desktops.

III. All laptops are printers.

IV. Some monitors are printers.

options.text: Only conclusions I and IV follow
Only conclusions I and II follow
Only conclusions II and III follow
Only conclusions III and IV follow
